title: Building a Strong Base Resume: Tips & Tricks
description:
Building a strong base resume is one of the best things you can do as a job seeker. 

You may have heard of a "master resume" or "foundational resume." That's exactly what this is—a a main document that contains everything you've ever done, so you can just erase or remove the things that aren't relevant to a particular job.

You can create your base resume in Google Docs or MS Word if you want—but here we'll show you how to do it for free using @teal_hq.
